acceptance_criteria: App.tsx no longer imports or renders PracticeLobby
App.tsx Screen type has 'practice-completion' and no 'practice-lobby'
practiceProfile state is initialized with currentLevel: 2 in App.tsx
handleStartPractice calls getNextPracticeActivity(practiceProfile) and navigates to 'practice-activity'

`npm run build` passes with zero TypeScript errors and no unused imports

findings: Build passed with zero TS errors. PracticeLobby.tsx did not exist (was already removed by a prior step). INTEGRATION VERIFICATION (iteration 1): Cross-FEAT integration verified — `npm run build` passes clean (exit code 0, zero TS errors, zero unused imports).
